turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Fitment Concierge
How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
FASS diesel fuel systems and accessories usually ship out within 2 to 3 business days after your order is placed.
If your order includes items from other manufacturers, lead times can vary depending on the product, brand, and build schedule, and tracking is emailed as soon as the package leaves the facility.
If you'd like me to look up your specific order, please share your order number and email address!

FASS Motorsports does not offer financial compensation or shipping fee refunds for carrier delays, as transit times and carrier schedules are outside our direct control.
If a manufacturer lead time changes significantly and no longer works with your timeline, our team can help you look for alternative in-stock products or discuss next steps for your order.
